Definitely NOT authentically Vietnamese. The worst meal I've had so far.
Jul 2026 • Friends
Well I should have taken more note of the bad reviews. 
1. This place is not Trip Advisor Awarded as advertised outside. 
2. Definitely not family run unless owned by big family bosses. 
3. I did not view this as authentically Vietnamese, Cesear Salad with dodgy looking chicken. No Papaya, Mango salad or other authentic foods. 
4. They offered a free item if you gave a good review on Trip Advisor and Google. 
5. Noisy music - they did turn it down a little when requested but the noise overall was unbearable. 
6. If anyone thinks this is the best restaurant in Vietnam they have obviously just arrived or fancied some free gift. 
Do yourself a favour Walk on By.
